title: Hidden behind the obvious: misleading keywords and implicitly abusive language on social media

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating BERT model classification performance on data subsets split by the presence or absence of explicit keywords (slurs and profanity) to measure the model's over-reliance on surface-level terms, false positive rates on non-abusive keyword use, and false negative rates on implicit abuse.

bias_targets.target: Identity-based bias (Ethnicity, Gender, Religion, Sexual Orientation, Nationality, Disability, Class)
bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution, frequency, and class-association of topic-specific demographic slurs (using the Hatebase lexicon) across abusive, offensive, and normal speech categories in multiple datasets.
